issue:
Pydantic error URLs are using VERSION instead of version_short()

Code to reproduce:
```python
from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic.errors import PydanticUserError

# Try to instantiate BaseModel directly
model = BaseModel()
```

Results in:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File "pydantic/main.py", line 340, in __new__
    raise PydanticUserError(
pydantic.errors.PydanticUserError: Pydantic models should inherit from BaseModel, BaseModel cannot be instantiated directly

For further information visit https://errors.pydantic.dev/2.1.0/u/base-model-instantiated
```

The error URL is using the full version (e.g., "2.1.0") instead of the short version (e.g., "2.1"). This causes the link to be incorrect since the documentation site uses the short version format.
